+# Prism RL 资产
+
+适用范围：账号 `kayson`，用户指定的 `CQ-科研驾驶舱` 工作空间，项目 `多模态自进化科学模型`。调度配额、可用 GPU 和平台状态每次从 Inspire Live 查询；本文件只记录共享资产及环境合同。
+
+| 资产 | 固定位置 / 身份 |
+| --- | --- |
+| Native Prism 预训练 RUN | `/inspire/qb-ilm2/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/yangxiaogui/mossLite/RUNs/delivery/pretrain/prism_pretrain_1.7B_v0.4.0` |
+| 本次导出 iteration | `checkpoints/iter_0100000`，模型组件为其 `model/` DCP |
+| 对应 HF/Omni 制品 | `/inspire/ssd/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/src/vox/artifacts/prism17b-v04/hf-iter-0100000` |
+| Codec | `/inspire/qb-ilm2/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/models/MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer-v2` |
+| 转换命令与检查记录 | `/inspire/ssd/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/src/vox/artifacts/prism17b-v04/conversion-command.sh`、`conversion-report.json` |
+| GPU 容器镜像 | `voxrl:editable-v1-slim`；固定镜像 digest `sha256:f98aa62c7a9926dd7ab42925953459dc33f759f78654692cbea8293abf2dc484` |
+| 隔离训练 Python | `/inspire/ssd/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/src/vox/artifacts/prism17b-v04/gpu-validation/training-env/bin/python` |
+| Omni Python | 镜像内 `/opt/venvs/core/bin/python` |
+
+HF 制品由 mossLite 的官方 native 转换工具在 CPU 上生成。结构为 24 RVQ、32 物理层、H2048、MLP-only 28–31、BF16；执行中的重复层保留物理参数共享。模型初始化使用 native DCP 模型组件，RL 续训使用 slime 自己的完整 checkpoint。
+
+首次初始化通过通用 `--custom-megatron-model-initializer-path` 指定 Prism 插件，来源使用 `--pretrained-checkpoint`，可选 step 使用 `--ckpt-step`。源 checkpoint 格式识别留在插件中；显式 `--load` 完整恢复优先。示例环境变量仍使用 `PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT` / `PRISM_PRETRAINED_STEP`，训练主包没有对应的 Prism 专属参数。
+
+Prism learner 使用 Megatron 原生 TE layer spec 与 `TEDotProductAttention`，后端沿用 Megatron 默认 `auto` 选择。模型包不再直接依赖 `flash_attn.cute` wrapper；TE 根据实际环境选择底层 attention kernel。Omni 的推理后端由其独立配置和运行时选择。
+
+训练 Python 的 NumPy 1.26.4、Transformers 5.0.0、SciPy 1.14.1、PyArrow 18.1.0 安装在独立 venv；通过其 `.pth` 和 NVIDIA runtime 符号链接引用镜像内的 Torch/TE。PyArrow 版本需要同时兼容 NumPy 1 与 Ray 的序列化，单独导入 Ray 不足以验证这一项。Omni 使用原 core 的 NumPy 2.3.5、Transformers 5.12.1。两者引用相同的 Torch 2.13.0+cu130 和 TE 2.17.0 二进制，Megatron Core 为 0.19.0。这份训练 venv 依赖镜像内 `/opt/` 的库位置，应在上述 GPU 镜像中使用。
+
+启动 Ray head/node 时也使用训练 Python，保证其默认 worker 解释器具备相同的训练依赖。Omni 的独立 Python 由 `--omni-python` 指定。不要通过继承到 Omni 子进程的 `PYTHONPATH` 切换 NumPy/Transformers 版本。
+
+GPU 验收源码使用 `git archive <完整 SHA>` 写入各验收入口独立的 `source/<SHA>/` 子目录，真实绝对路径由 source manifest 记录。每次 workload 使用新的结果目录，保留完整响应、逐动作分数、发布版本和清理结果；运行中的 snapshot 不修改。临时 workload 名称与结果属于验收记录，不作为永久服务地址。
+
+本项目后续 GPU 验收的大文件输出放在 `/inspire/qb-ilm2/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/vox-slime-validation/prism17b-v04/`。其中 `ray-attempt-005/checkpoint/` 是使用明确标注的工程奖励产生的完整 RL checkpoint，作为 optimizer 与断点恢复的验证 fixture；它不代表语音质量训练结果。CPU 工具、HF 制品与代码入口的原共享路径保留。
+
+共卡运行使用同一镜像与训练 Python。经过验证的 Omni 源码解释器入口为
+`/inspire/ssd/project/cq-scientific-cooperation-zone/public/kyu/src/vox/artifacts/prism17b-v04/gpu-validation/colocate-smoke/attempt-006/omni-python`；
+该 wrapper 在原 `/opt/venvs/core/bin/python` 前固定 Omni 源码路径，源码 SHA 记录在同目录
+`sources.json`。设置 `OMNI_PYTHON` 指向此入口、`COLOCATE=1`，单卡 Ray 使用一个 GPU，
+并设置 `ACTOR_GPUS_PER_NODE=ROLLOUT_GPUS=GPUS_PER_NODE=1`。
+
+QB 根目录中的 `colocate-005/fresh/checkpoint/` 与 `colocate-006/resume/checkpoint/`
+是工程奖励下的共卡完整 RL checkpoint fixture；联合报告为 `colocate-006/verification.json`。
+端口、Ray head 和平台 workload 均为临时资源，后续运行重新分配。

+# Prism GRPO 与多 domain MOPD
+
+这套示例使用原 `train.py`、Ray placement、rollout 分组、Megatron optimizer 和 checkpoint。学生生成仍走 Omni Python router；Megatron 在每批更新前重放轨迹并固定旧学生 logprob。Omni 返回的逐动作分数用于对齐检查，默认不作为 PPO 分母。
+
+首版固定 BF16、TP=PP=CP=1、关闭 sequence parallel，支持 learner DP 和多个完整 rollout 副本。Prism 的全部 RVQ 与 sampled stop 参与训练。模型输入按真实时间行 packing，策略目标按真实动作计算；自然结束的 terminal stop 与零帧 stop 不会丢失。
+
+Attention 沿用 Megatron 原生 `TEDotProductAttention`，使用框架默认的 `auto` 后端选择；`--attention-backend` 仍由原 Megatron 参数控制。模型使用原 TE layer spec，不再替换为自定义 FA4 wrapper。旧学生分数以 Megatron 重算为默认。训练持续报告逐动作平均绝对误差，以及 `mean_sample_train_rollout_logprob_max_abs_diff`：每条轨迹先取真实动作的最大误差，再由原 microbatch/DP 报表平均，因而该值不是全 DP 的 global max。两个来源的 RVQ/stop 分数均保留在训练 payload 和可选 debug dump 中。严格的跨引擎精度对齐作为独立工作处理；GPU 工程闭环通过不代表满足任意更紧的 logprob 容差。
+
+实际原 `train.py` 的 GPU 训练、保存、恢复与多副本验收范围及报告位置见 [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md)。其中工程奖励与真实质量奖励的验收范围分别写明。
+
+| 训练方式 | 原生训练路径 | 额外输入 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| GRPO | prompt 组奖励优势 → native PPO clipping | WER、SIM、全局指令奖励服务 |
+| MOPD | native OPD advantage → native PPO clipping | 按 domain 路由的冻结 Prism 教师 |
+
+MOPD 的 RVQ 和 stop 都使用学生实际选择动作的 logprob，不使用完整 stop KL。每条语音的目标归约为 `mean(RVQ losses) + STOP_LOSS_WEIGHT × mean(stop losses)`。这采用 slime 的 OPD/PPO 目标，不要求重现旧 VoxRL 的不同蒸馏 surrogate。
+
+## 解释器与资产
+
+需要两个可独立选择的 Python 环境：
+
+- `TRAIN_PYTHON`：当前 slime、Ray、PyTorch、Megatron Core/training、Transformer Engine、FlashAttention 和对应训练依赖。
+- `OMNI_PYTHON`：当前 SGLang-Omni、Prism pipeline 和 Omni Python router。由 Ray actor 用这个解释器启动完整 pipeline。
+
+训练与 Omni 的 NCCL、CUDA 和 PyTorch 组合需要能够互相传输 GPU tensor。所有 Ray 节点均须可读取模型、pipeline YAML、数据和音频引用。若 Megatron 未安装到训练环境，可用 `MEGATRON_ROOT` 指定其源码目录；脚本将其加入训练 workers 的 `PYTHONPATH`。
+
+新运行需要：
+
+```bash
+export TRAIN_PYTHON=/path/to/training-env/bin/python
+export OMNI_PYTHON=/path/to/omni-env/bin/python
+export HF_CHECKPOINT=/assets/prism-student-hf
+export PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT=/assets/prism-native-dcp
+export CODEC_MODEL=/assets/moss-audio-tokenizer-v2
+export PROMPT_DATA=/data/prism-train.jsonl
+export OUTPUT_DIR=/runs/prism-grpo
+# 可选：固定 native iteration；未指定时使用 importer 的 checkpoint 选择规则。
+export PRISM_PRETRAINED_STEP=100000
+```
+
+HF 制品与 native DCP 必须对应同一个学生结构、执行计划、tokenizer/codec 和参数精度。HF 制品提供 Omni 权重、processor、prompt protocol 和模型配置；native DCP initializer 只加载预训练模型，RL optimizer 从新状态开始。恢复 slime RL checkpoint 时使用 `RL_LOAD`，保留原 optimizer、scheduler 和训练进度。
+
+脚本先由模型插件读取 HF 配置，生成普通 Megatron 架构参数，再进入原参数解析与 HF 校验。主包不判断 Prism 的模型类型。首次权重初始化使用通用接口：
+
+```text
+--custom-megatron-model-initializer-path slime_plugins.models.prism.load_prism_pretrained
+--pretrained-checkpoint <native RUN / checkpoint root / iteration>
+--ckpt-step <optional native iteration>
+```
+
+initializer 接收 `(models, args)`，只加载模型权重并返回 `None`；框架负责同步低精度 optimizer 的 master 参数和设置新训练进度。mossLite 目录、manifest、分片布局与模型身份的识别全部留在插件中。`PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT`、`PRISM_PRETRAINED_STEP` 仍是示例脚本的环境变量，脚本将它们转换成上述通用参数；旧的 Prism 专属 checkpoint CLI 参数已移除。明确的 iteration 目录可以同时提供一致的 step，冲突会报错。
+
+显式 `--load` 始终优先于 initializer，并走原 Megatron/HF 加载路径。错误的显式路径不会回退成重新初始化。恢复脚本仅传 `--load`，不附带首次初始化的 hook、source 或 step。
+
+## JSONL 输入
+
+脚本使用 `--input-key script --metadata-key metadata`，不应用文本 chat template。实际 prompt 由 Omni processor 渲染。参见 [prompts.example.jsonl](prompts.example.jsonl)：
+
+```json
+{
+  "script": "你好，欢迎来到今天的节目。",
+  "metadata": {
+    "domain": "chinese",
+    "omni_prompt": {
+      "task_type": "Full VoiceClone",
+      "show_language": false,
+      "language": "zh",
+      "transcript_target": "你好，欢迎来到今天的节目。",
+      "global_instruction": {"Gender": "female"},
+      "references": [{"id": "audio1", "uri": "/assets/reference-zh.wav"}],
+      "reference_targets": {"timbre": "audio1"}
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+每行必须显式提供 `task_type` 和布尔 `show_language`。`references` 的 `id` 对应实际参考 URI；使用 SIM 时，`reference_targets.timbre` 必须明确指向音色参考。`transcript_target` 与 `language` 供 WER/CER 客户端使用，不传给 ASR 解码器。
+
+启用 JudgeCLAP 时，`global_instruction` 是实际交给 processor 的全局属性 object 或其 JSON 字符串。属性必须同时属于实际 Prism renderer 与 JudgeCLAP 支持的英文规范类别。第一版只评分全局属性，不把全局分数用于局部片段指令。空属性或普通自由文本不能作为这条 JudgeCLAP 路径的评分目标。
+
+MOPD 使用 `metadata.domain` 选择教师。domain 的采样比例由数据记录比例及数据源决定，不由教师响应速度决定。显式 domain 没有教师映射时会报错。
+
+## Ray 资源
+
+设置 `COLOCATE=1` 可让 learner 与完整学生 Omni pipeline 共用 GPU。例如在只有一张
+GPU 的 Ray cluster 上运行：
+
+```bash
+export COLOCATE=1
+export ACTOR_GPUS_PER_NODE=1 ROLLOUT_GPUS=1 GPUS_PER_NODE=1
+bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh
+```
+
+需要使用支持 tensor 更新和显存释放的 Omni 版本。脚本传入原生 `--colocate`，由 slime
+启用 learner/rollout 的 offload，并选择原 `UpdateWeightFromTensor`，通过 CUDA IPC
+传递 SGLang flattened buckets。`--update-weight-transport nccl` 仍沿用原参数默认值，
+共卡时 factory 根据 `--colocate` 选择 tensor 路径。
+
+Omni adapter 自动启用 pipeline 的 `enable_memory_saver`，释放 AR 权重、KV/graph 内存，
+并将参考编码器和 vocoder 的持久状态备份到 CPU。先恢复 weights、完成全部权重桶发布，
+再恢复 KV/graph，之后才开放下一轮生成。当前 SGLang 的 breakable prefill graph 不支持
+memory saver，因此共卡使用 eager prefill 和 eager vocoder，AR decode graph 保留。
+外部冻结教师仍需要自己的资源。完整 RL checkpoint 的保存与恢复方式相同。
+
+主循环会在训练前确定本轮是否保存 checkpoint。保存轮次让 learner 在训练后保持 GPU
+驻留，完成保存后再 offload，省去一次保存前的换出、换入；由原 `SAVE_INTERVAL`
+控制，无需增加开关。有 critic 时只保留最后训练的角色，避免两个训练模型同时驻留。
+
+以下单机例子保留 GPU 0 给 learner、GPU 1 给一个完整学生 pipeline。教师和奖励服务使用其他 GPU 或其他机器，并在 Ray 管理的学生资源之外运行。
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 "$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m ray.scripts.scripts start \
+  --head --num-gpus=2 --num-cpus=16 \
+  --dashboard-port=8265 --disable-usage-stats
+export RAY_ADDRESS=auto
+export ACTOR_GPUS_PER_NODE=1
+export ROLLOUT_GPUS=1
+export GPUS_PER_NODE=2
+```
+
+Ray 默认 worker 的 Python 由启动 head/node 的解释器决定，因此使用上面的 `TRAIN_PYTHON` 模块入口启动；`PATH` 中的裸 `ray` 命令可能属于另一个环境。多节点时，各节点的 Ray 进程也须从兼容的训练环境启动。已有集群的 workers 必须具备同一训练环境所需的 Python 依赖；如果不匹配，应另建专用训练 cluster，脚本不会自动停止或替换现有集群。`OMNI_PYTHON` 仅用于独立启动 Omni pipeline 与 router，不能修复 learner worker 的环境。
+
+脚本连接已有 Ray cluster，不停止现有进程。一个 rollout GPU 对应一个完整 Prism pipeline；该 pipeline 内 preprocessing、AR 和 vocoder 共用这一张 rollout GPU。默认训练 GPU 与 rollout GPU 分离；`COLOCATE=1` 时使用共卡切换。
+
+增加学生副本时设置 `ROLLOUT_GPUS=2`，并让 Ray 提供 learner 加上两个 rollout GPU。生成仍调用一个 router，权重通过 NCCL 安装到两个 AR 接收者，全部安装成功后才开放下一轮生成。`ACTOR_NODES × ACTOR_GPUS_PER_NODE` 是 learner DP 大小；`GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE` 必须能被它整除。跨节点时显式填写每节点的 `GPUS_PER_NODE`。
+
+## GRPO
+
+先启动符合 `voxrl.scoring.v1` 的冻结服务。这里沿用现有评分协议：Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 提供转写，ReDimNet2-B6 提供 speaker embedding，JudgeCLAP adapter 与其 Qwen2.5-Omni 基座提供全局属性评分。服务部署和模型环境独立于 learner；启用的服务需要 `/info`，以及对应的 `/score` 或 `/embed`。
+
+`configure.py` 从已运行服务的 `/info` 读取并固定 fingerprint，生成当前 run 的明确配置：
+
+```bash
+export RUN_CONFIG=/runs/prism-grpo-config
+"$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m examples.prism.configure \
+  --student "$HF_CHECKPOINT" --codec "$CODEC_MODEL" --output "$RUN_CONFIG" \
+  --reward wer http://asr-host:8101 0.6 \
+  --reward sim http://sim-host:8102 0.2 \
+  --reward judge_clap http://judge-host:8103 0.2
+export OMNI_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/student.yaml"
+export REWARD_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/rewards.yaml"
+export AUDIO_DIR=/shared/prism-grpo-audio
+NUM_ROLLOUT=1 bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh
+```
+
+上述权重只是示例，应按实验显式选择。只用 WER 与 SIM 时，省去 `--reward judge_clap ...`，无需提供可评分指令。配置 schema 参见 [rewards.example.yaml](rewards.example.yaml)。
+
+`audio_transport: path` 要求评分服务能读取生成音频和 SIM 参考音频的相同绝对路径。服务不共享文件系统时，可在生成配置时加 `--audio-transport upload`；rollout/评分客户端仍需能够读取本地参考文件。评分服务故障会抛出错误，不会静默变成 reward 0。零帧 sampled stop 是合法轨迹，音频奖励为明确的无音频结果，stop 仍参与组优势训练。
+
+GRPO 默认每个 prompt 生成四条、每批两个 prompt。可设置 `PROMPTS_PER_BATCH`、`SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT` 和 `GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE`。组优势在完整 prompt group 上计算后再进入 DP 分片。
+
+同一批数据需要按样本选择不同奖励时，在每条 prompt 的 `metadata.reward_category` 中显式填写 `base`、`voiceclone` 或 `instruction`，并通过原自定义奖励入口启用分类路由：
+
+```bash
+export PROMPT_DATA=/data/prism-category-prompts.jsonl
+bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh \
+  --custom-rm-path examples.prism.rewards.reward
+```
+
+`base` 只评分 WER/CER，`voiceclone` 评分 WER/CER 与 SIM，`instruction` 评分 WER/CER 与全局 JudgeCLAP。每个类别沿用 `REWARD_CONFIG` 中对应分量的系数直接求和，只调用自己需要的服务；同一 prompt group 的候选使用相同类别，组优势仍按原 GRPO 处理。类别独立于 `domain` 和 Prism `task_type`，缺失或未知类别会报错。默认奖励入口继续接受原有未填写类别的数据。
+
+完整配置、输入约束及记录方式见 [REWARD_CATEGORIES.md](REWARD_CATEGORIES.md)，数据模板见 [category-prompts.example.jsonl](category-prompts.example.jsonl)。
+
+## 多 domain MOPD
+
+本示例把教师作为外部、冻结的 score-only Omni 服务管理。分别启动两个教师，例如在两个独立终端：
+
+```bash
+export TEACHER_ZH=/assets/prism-teacher-zh
+export TEACHER_EN=/assets/prism-teacher-en
+
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 "$OMNI_PYTHON" -m sglang_omni.cli serve \
+  --config examples/prism/teacher-score.yaml --model-path "$TEACHER_ZH" \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8201
+
+# 另一个终端
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 "$OMNI_PYTHON" -m sglang_omni.cli serve \
+  --config examples/prism/teacher-score.yaml --model-path "$TEACHER_EN" \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8202
+```
+
+待教师健康后，在训练环境运行：
+
+```bash
+export RUN_CONFIG=/runs/prism-mopd-config
+export OUTPUT_DIR=/runs/prism-mopd
+"$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m examples.prism.configure \
+  --student "$HF_CHECKPOINT" --codec "$CODEC_MODEL" --output "$RUN_CONFIG" \
+  --teacher zh_teacher http://teacher-host:8201 "$TEACHER_ZH" \
+  --teacher en_teacher http://teacher-host:8202 "$TEACHER_EN" \
+  --domain chinese zh_teacher --domain english en_teacher
+export OMNI_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/student.yaml"
+export TEACHER_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/teachers.yaml"
+NUM_ROLLOUT=1 bash examples/prism/run-mopd.sh
+```
+
+教师配置 schema 参见 [teachers.example.yaml](teachers.example.yaml)。`configure.py` 从本地教师 artifact 构造 `model_identity`，核验服务返回的身份，并固定 `/model_info` 中的 `teacher_weight_sha256`。该值是教师启动时对已加载 tensor 计算的 checksum，不是某个 safetensors 文件的 hash；训练期间不逐步重新 hash 全模型。存在认证时，可用 `--teacher-auth-token-env ENV_NAME` 把环境变量名称写入配置；运行 rollout hook 的进程需要有该变量。
+
+教师可以比学生大，但必须有兼容的 Prism codec、动作空间、特殊 token、tokenizer 和 replay 语义。教师重放的是学生已经生成的相同 typed prompt 与动作前缀。MOPD 默认每个 prompt 一条轨迹、关闭波形输出，使用示例 `zero_reward` hook 提供零 task reward；原生 OPD 将教师相对旧学生的 selected-action 分数加入 advantage。`OPD_KL_COEF` 控制该项权重。
+
+固定 `endpoint` 指向实际 score worker，直接调用 `/score_actions`。学生 router 的 `/generate` 负载均衡继续沿用。
+
+也可以交给 slime 管理教师的 Ray 资源与生命周期。复制并填写 [managed-deployment.example.yaml](managed-deployment.example.yaml)，使用一张学生 rollout GPU、两张教师 GPU；两个教师必须设置 `update_weights: false` 并使用 score-only pipeline。教师绑定中用 `deployment: teacher_zh` 替代 `endpoint`，两者必须恰选一个。hook 从该 named router 的 `/workers` 找到可用冻结副本，再直连实际 worker 的 `/score_actions`，不会向 router 发送评分请求。
+
+需要事先固定教师身份与已加载 tensor checksum。可对已启动、使用相同制品和 score 配置的教师进行一次显式检查，并让配置工具写入 managed 字段：
+
+```bash
+"$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m examples.prism.configure \
+  --student "$HF_CHECKPOINT" --codec "$CODEC_MODEL" --output /runs/prism-managed-config \
+  --teacher zh_teacher http://teacher-host:8201 "$TEACHER_ZH" \
+  --teacher en_teacher http://teacher-host:8202 "$TEACHER_EN" \
+  --domain chinese zh_teacher --domain english en_teacher \
+  --deployment zh_teacher teacher_zh --deployment en_teacher teacher_en
+```
+
+把 managed deployment 模板中的 `omni_config` 和模型路径填为实际资产，确保 Ray 独占其管理的 GPU，再启动：
+
+```bash
+export OMNI_CONFIG=/runs/prism-managed-config/student.yaml
+export TEACHER_CONFIG=/runs/prism-managed-config/teachers.yaml
+export ROLLOUT_GPUS=3  # 包含学生与两个冻结教师
+export GPUS_PER_NODE=4 # 再加一张 learner GPU
+bash examples/prism/run-mopd.sh --sglang-config /runs/prism-managed-deployment.yaml
+```
+
+多个教师副本沿用相同绑定；hook 按 sample/group 编号确定性选择健康可用 worker。训练过程中不会自动信任新的教师 checksum，返回身份和固定绑定不一致时仍会报错。
+
+## 恢复、配置检查与首轮验收
+
+恢复时保持同一算法、采样和服务配置，使用 slime 的完整 RL checkpoint：
+
+```bash
+export RL_LOAD="$OUTPUT_DIR"
+bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh
+# 或相应的 run-mopd.sh
+```
+
+`NUM_ROLLOUT` 沿用原框架的总 rollout 上限，续训时需要大于 checkpoint 中已经完成的 rollout。恢复 `iter_0000000` 时，下一次训练为 rollout 1，恢复后的首次完整学生发布为版本 2；下一次更新后发布版本 3。已有更高 serving/recovery 版本会保留。新模型初始化仍从 rollout 0 与首次发布版本 1 开始。
+
+`PRISM_DRY_RUN=1 bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh` 会检查必需输入并打印实际命令，不创建 GPU 作业。可在脚本末尾附加原 slime 参数，例如 `--save-debug-train-data '/runs/debug/train-{rollout_id}.pt'`。示例使用同步 `train.py` 和 `flush_cache_interval=1`；默认分卡，可设置 `COLOCATE=1` 启用共卡和 offload。未启用 TIS、reference KL、GSPO 或完整 stop KL。
+
+首个实际 GPU 验收应固定少量 prompt、短帧预算和 `NUM_ROLLOUT=1`，检查 native checkpoint 加载、所有 RVQ/stop 重放分数、梯度及完整权重发布，再增加 rollout 副本进行同样验证。CPU 接缝测试支持绑定 HF 配置而不加载权重：
+
+```bash
+SLIME_TEST_PRISM_HF_CHECKPOINT="$HF_CHECKPOINT" "$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m pytest \
+  tests/test_prism_rollout_integration.py tests/test_policy_actions.py \
+  tests/test_prism_model.py -q
+```
+
+仓库提供独立 GPU 工程验收入口。它先加载 native 学生并发布版本 1，再通过 Omni router 生成真实轨迹，核对更新前 logprob，执行一次 native policy objective/Megatron Adam 更新，发布版本 2，并核对更新后生成动作的 logprob。下面使用 learner GPU 0 和 Omni GPU 1；把 `--gpus` 改为 `1,2` 可在三张以上 GPU 上验证两个完整副本：
+
+```bash
+cat > /runs/prism-smoke-options.json <<'JSON'
+{"alignment_atol": 0.05, "alignment_rtol": 0, "learner_max_frames": 8, "learning_rate": 0.001}
+JSON
+
+"$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m scripts.test_prism_omni \
+  --hf-checkpoint "$HF_CHECKPOINT" --config "$OMNI_CONFIG" \
+  --python "$OMNI_PYTHON" --gpus 1 \
+  --artifact-dir /runs/prism-publication-smoke \
+  --native-checkpoint "$PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT" \
+  --mode publication \
+  --publication-hook scripts.prism_publication_smoke:publication \
+  --post-generation-hook scripts.prism_publication_smoke:verify_generated \
+  --publication-args-json /runs/prism-smoke-options.json \
+  --expected-version 2 --max-frames 8
+```
+
+`0.05` 是这里显式选定的 BF16 数值容差示例；结果会分别报告 RVQ 与 stop 的最大和平均误差。该工程检查使用一个明确的非零 advantage 来验证反向和权重更新，不调用实际 reward model，也不替代完整 prompt group 的 GRPO 或 domain 教师训练验收。独立脚本直接使用 engine 控制方法，没有执行 Ray placement；实际训练的资源生命周期仍由 `train.py` 管理。
+
+`--mode static` 可单独检查 HF artifact、pipeline、router 和真实 rollout 协议，省去两个 hook 及 native checkpoint。这个模式不发布 learner 权重，结果会明确记录这一点。原始 `/generate` JSON、typed replay、更新前后分数和清理状态均写入结果目录。

+# Prism 样本奖励类别
+
+`examples.prism.rewards.reward` 是这套示例自己的奖励入口。类别函数和
+`CATEGORY_REWARDS` 映射均在 `examples/prism/rewards.py`，基础评分客户端复用
+`slime_plugins.tts_reward`。数据中的 domain、Prism task type 与奖励类别分别保留。
+
+| `metadata.reward_category` | 固定启用的评分分量 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `base` | WER/CER |
+| `voiceclone` | WER/CER + SIM |
+| `instruction` | WER/CER + JudgeCLAP |
+
+统一入口要求每条 prompt 显式填写类别，未知或缺失类别会报错。每个 GRPO prompt group
+的候选继承同一类别；批量调用也检查这一约束。
+类别不会根据 `domain` 或 `task_type` 自动推断。
+
+## 配置与启动
+
+沿用现有 `REWARD_CONFIG` 的 `services` 和 `weights` 格式。每个类别只调用自己启用
+的服务，所需分量必须有服务绑定和正权重；其他类别的服务可以省略。不同类别共享同一
+评分服务的 fingerprint 缓存和并发上限。
+
+例如，用现有配置工具将三个系数显式设为 `1.0`：
+
+```bash
+"$TRAIN_PYTHON" -m examples.prism.configure \
+  --student "$HF_CHECKPOINT" --codec "$CODEC_MODEL" --output "$RUN_CONFIG" \
+  --reward wer http://asr-host:8101 1.0 \
+  --reward sim http://sim-host:8102 1.0 \
+  --reward judge_clap http://judge-host:8103 1.0
+
+export OMNI_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/student.yaml"
+export REWARD_CONFIG="$RUN_CONFIG/rewards.yaml"
+export PROMPT_DATA=/data/prism-category-prompts.jsonl
+bash examples/prism/run-grpo.sh \
+  --custom-rm-path examples.prism.rewards.reward
+```
+
+此时三类分别得到 `WER_reward`、`WER_reward + SIM_reward`、
+`WER_reward + JudgeCLAP_reward`。WER/CER 分量沿用 `1 / (1 + error_rate)`；SIM
+沿用非负 cosine similarity；JudgeCLAP 沿用全局属性分数平均。修改 `weights` 可以
+调整分量系数，但类别要求的分量不能通过零权重关闭。reward 总和不再额外归一化，
+后续组优势仍由原 GRPO 流程计算。
+
+参见 `category-prompts.example.jsonl`，填写实际参考音频路径后作为数据模板使用。
+每行填写 `metadata.reward_category`，其他 Prism 输入沿用已有协议：
+
+- `base`：需要 `transcript_target` 和 `language`，不需要 SIM 参考或 JudgeCLAP 属性。
+- `voiceclone`：还需要有效的音色参考。示例显式填写 Full VoiceClone 的完整参考属性映射。
+- `instruction`：还需要可被 JudgeCLAP 评分的全局属性指令；该类别不会调用 SIM。

+
+在同一作业、同一张 H200 上，从 `colocate-006/resume/checkpoint/iter_0000002`
+分别恢复旧流程与优化后的流程，各运行 rollout 3。两组均使用四条八帧轨迹、工程奖励和
+完整 checkpoint 保存，Omni source 固定为 `bb73d42c16f246ff493e676b0d9242b61f9d89f3`。
+旧 slime source 为 `8bcae7e898efeaaed9218ad02c458dfb2b5d66b0`，优化后的 source 为

+
+| 训练完成至权重发布之间的操作 | 旧流程 | 优化后 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 训练结束后的第一次 sleep | 7.7 s | 省去 |
+| 为保存执行 wake_up | 2.7 s | 省去 |
+| 保存完成后的 sleep | 7.7 s | 8.5 s |

+`train → save → sleep → publish`，保存前仍同步 CUDA 并清理临时分配。模型驻留状态由
+worker 记录；普通训练调用默认仍在结束时 offload。Actor/critic 顺序、异步保存的

+"""Prepare concrete example configs from local assets and frozen services.
+
+This reads /model_info and /info once; it never installs weights or launches
+servers. Run from the repository root with the training Python environment.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+import yaml
+
+from slime.backends.sglang_utils.omni_engine import validate_admin_result
+from slime_plugins.omni_rollout import PrismConfig
+from slime_plugins.tts_reward import PROTOCOL
+
+
+def request_json(endpoint, route, payload=None, token=None):
+    parsed = urlsplit(endpoint)
+    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.netloc or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        raise ValueError("Service endpoint must be an HTTP(S) base URL without query or fragment")
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if token:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+    request = Request(
+        endpoint.rstrip("/") + route,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None,
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    with urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
+        result = json.load(response)
+    if not isinstance(result, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{route} must return a JSON object")
+    return result
+
+
+def teacher_binding(endpoint, checkpoint, auth_env=None):
+    token = os.environ.get(auth_env) if auth_env else None
+    if auth_env and not token:
+        raise ValueError(f"Teacher token environment {auth_env!r} is missing")
+    body = validate_admin_result(
+        request_json(endpoint, "/model_info", {"stages": ["tts_engine"], "timeout_s": 20}, token),
+        "model_info",
+    )
+    stage = body["results"][0]["data"]
+    infos = [stage] + [rank["data"] for rank in stage.get("rank_results", [])]
+    candidates = [info for info in infos if info.get("supports_action_scoring") is True]
+    if not candidates:
+        raise ValueError("The teacher endpoint must run MossTTSPrismScorePipelineConfig")
+    info = candidates[0]
+    checksum = info.get("teacher_weight_sha256")
+    if (
+        info.get("supports_weight_update") is not False
+        or info.get("stage_tp_size", 1) != 1
+        or not isinstance(checksum, str)
+        or len(checksum) != 64
+        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in checksum)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Teacher info must report frozen TP1 weights and their loaded tensor checksum")
+    asset = PrismConfig.from_path(checkpoint)
+    if info.get("model_identity") != asset.identity:
+        raise ValueError("Teacher endpoint identity differs from the supplied local inference artifact")
+    for candidate in candidates[1:]:
+        if candidate.get("teacher_weight_sha256") != checksum or candidate.get("model_identity") != asset.identity:
+            raise ValueError("Teacher stage/rank identities disagree")
+    result = {
+        "endpoint": endpoint.rstrip("/"),
+        "checkpoint": str(Path(checkpoint).resolve()),
+        "model_identity": asset.identity,
+        "weight_sha256": checksum,
+    }
+    if auth_env:
+        result["auth_token_env"] = auth_env
+    return result
+
+
+def write_config(path, value):
+    if path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"Choose a fresh output directory; refusing to overwrite {path}")
+    path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(value, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--student", required=True, help="Local Prism inference artifact")
+    parser.add_argument("--codec", required=True, help="Local codec artifact or explicit model ID")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path, help="Fresh directory for concrete YAML files")
+    parser.add_argument("--teacher", action="append", nargs=3, default=[], metavar=("NAME", "ENDPOINT", "CHECKPOINT"))
+    parser.add_argument("--domain", action="append", nargs=2, default=[], metavar=("DOMAIN", "TEACHER_NAME"))
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--deployment",
+        action="append",
+        nargs=2,
+        default=[],
+        metavar=("TEACHER_NAME", "DEPLOYMENT_NAME"),
+        help="After explicitly inspecting the teacher endpoint, bind it to a frozen named slime deployment",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--teacher-auth-token-env", help="Environment variable read by all configured teacher clients")
+    parser.add_argument("--reward", action="append", nargs=3, default=[], metavar=("NAME", "ENDPOINT", "WEIGHT"))
+    parser.add_argument("--audio-transport", choices=["path", "upload"], default="path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    PrismConfig.from_path(args.student)
+    models = {}
+    for name, endpoint, checkpoint in args.teacher:
+        if name in models:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate teacher name {name!r}")
+        models[name] = teacher_binding(endpoint, checkpoint, args.teacher_auth_token_env)
+    deployments = set()
+    for name, deployment in args.deployment:
+        if name not in models or name in deployments or deployment == "student":
+            raise ValueError("Managed binding must name one configured teacher and a frozen non-student deployment")
+        deployments.add(name)
+        models[name].pop("endpoint")
+        models[name]["deployment"] = deployment
+    domains = {}
+    for domain, name in args.domain:
+        if domain in domains or name not in models:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate domain or unknown teacher binding: {domain!r} -> {name!r}")
+        domains[domain] = name
+    if models and not domains:
+        raise ValueError("Specify explicit --domain mappings for multi-domain OPD")
+    services, weights = {}, {}
+    for name, endpoint, weight in args.reward:
+        if name not in {"wer", "sim", "judge_clap"} or name in services:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown or duplicate reward {name!r}")
+        weight = float(weight)
+        if not math.isfinite(weight) or weight <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Enabled reward weights must be finite and positive")
+        info = request_json(endpoint, "/info")
+        identity = info.get("identity", {})
+        if (
+            info.get("protocol") != PROTOCOL
+            or not isinstance(identity, dict)
+            or not isinstance(identity.get("fingerprint"), str)
+            or not identity["fingerprint"].strip()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Reward {name!r} does not implement {PROTOCOL} with a frozen identity")
+        services[name] = {
+            "endpoint": endpoint.rstrip("/"),
+            "expected_fingerprint": identity["fingerprint"],
+            "audio_transport": args.audio_transport,
+            "max_inflight": 2 if name == "judge_clap" else 4,
+        }
+        weights[name] = weight
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    write_config(
+        args.output / "student.yaml",
+        {
+            "config_cls": "MossTTSPrismPipelineConfig",
+            "model_path": str(Path(args.student).resolve()),
+            "codec_model_path": args.codec,
+            "enable_rl": True,
+        },
+    )
+    if models:
+        write_config(args.output / "teachers.yaml", {"models": models, "by_domain": domains})
+    if services:
+        write_config(args.output / "rewards.yaml", {"services": services, "weights": weights})
+    print(f"Wrote concrete Prism configs to {args.output.resolve()}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Example-owned reward categories for ``--custom-rm-path``.
+
+Samples select ``metadata.reward_category`` independently of their domain and
+Prism task type. Component coefficients and frozen service bindings retain the
+existing ``omni_reward_config`` schema. The common TTS clients own scoring,
+identity checks, timeouts, audio handling, and component failure propagation.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from slime_plugins import tts_reward
+
+
+class _CategoryRewards:
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        if not isinstance(config, Mapping) or set(config) != {"services", "weights"}:
+            raise ValueError("omni_reward_config requires services and weights mappings")
+        services, weights = config["services"], config["weights"]
+        if not isinstance(services, Mapping) or not isinstance(weights, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("reward services and weights must be mappings")
+        if set(weights) - {"wer", "sim", "judge_clap"}:
+            raise ValueError("supported reward components are wer, sim, and judge_clap")
+        self.weights = {name: tts_reward._finite(value, f"{name} weight") for name, value in weights.items()}
+        if any(weight < 0 for weight in self.weights.values()):
+            raise ValueError("reward weights must be nonnegative")
+        self.options = deepcopy(dict(services))
+        self.pipelines = {}
+        self.clients = {}
+
+    def pipeline(self, category, components):
+        if category not in self.pipelines:
+            missing = set(components) - self.weights.keys()
+            if missing:
+                raise ValueError(f"reward category {category!r} requires component weights: {sorted(missing)}")
+            weights = {name: self.weights[name] for name in components}
+            if any(weight <= 0 for weight in weights.values()):
+                raise ValueError(f"reward category {category!r} requires positive weights for {components}")
+            pipeline = tts_reward._Rewards({"services": self.options, "weights": weights})
+            # All categories share each service's identity cache and semaphore.
+            # Constructing a category is synchronous, before any scoring awaits.
+            pipeline.services = {
+                name: self.clients.setdefault(name, client) for name, client in pipeline.services.items()
+            }
+            self.pipelines[category] = pipeline
+        return self.pipelines[category]
+
+
+def _state(args):
+    state = getattr(args, "_prism_category_rewards", None)
+    if state is None:
+        state = _CategoryRewards(tts_reward._config(getattr(args, "omni_reward_config", None)))
+        args._prism_category_rewards = state
+    return state
+
+
+async def _gather_scores(coroutines):
+    outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*coroutines, return_exceptions=True)
+    for outcome in outcomes:
+        if isinstance(outcome, BaseException):
+            raise outcome
+    return outcomes
+
+
+async def _score_one(args, sample, category, components):
+    if not isinstance(getattr(sample, "metadata", None), dict):
+        raise ValueError("Prism category rewards require sample.metadata")
+    sample.metadata.pop("omni_reward", None)
+    pipeline = _state(args).pipeline(category, components)
+    try:
+        return await pipeline.score(sample)
+    finally:
+        outcome = sample.metadata.get("omni_reward")
+        if isinstance(outcome, dict):
+            outcome["category"] = category
+
+
+async def _score_category(args, sample, category, components):
+    if isinstance(sample, list):
+        return await _gather_scores(_score_one(args, item, category, components) for item in sample)
+    return await _score_one(args, sample, category, components)
+
+
+async def reward_base(args, sample, **kwargs):
+    """Base: WER/CER only."""
+    return await _score_category(args, sample, "base", ("wer",))
+
+
+async def reward_voiceclone(args, sample, **kwargs):
+    """Voice clone: WER/CER plus speaker similarity."""
+    return await _score_category(args, sample, "voiceclone", ("wer", "sim"))
+
+
+async def reward_instruction(args, sample, **kwargs):
+    """Instruction: WER/CER plus global JudgeCLAP instruction scoring."""
+    return await _score_category(args, sample, "instruction", ("wer", "judge_clap"))
+
+
+CATEGORY_REWARDS = {
+    "base": reward_base,
+    "voiceclone": reward_voiceclone,
+    "instruction": reward_instruction,
+}
+
+
+def _category(sample):
+    metadata = getattr(sample, "metadata", None)
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Prism category rewards require sample.metadata")
+    category = metadata.get("reward_category")
+    if not isinstance(category, str) or category not in CATEGORY_REWARDS:
+        raise ValueError(f"metadata.reward_category must be one of {tuple(CATEGORY_REWARDS)}; got {category!r}")
+    return category
+
+
+async def reward(args, sample, **kwargs):
+    """Dispatch a sample or ordered mixed-category batch to its reward function."""
+    if isinstance(sample, list):
+        categories = [_category(item) for item in sample]
+        group_categories = {}
+        for item, category in zip(sample, categories, strict=True):
+            group = getattr(item, "group_index", None)
+            if group is not None and group_categories.setdefault(group, category) != category:
+                raise ValueError("All candidates in a GRPO prompt group must use the same reward_category")
+        return await _gather_scores(
+            CATEGORY_REWARDS[category](args, item, **kwargs) for item, category in zip(sample, categories, strict=True)
+        )
+    return await CATEGORY_REWARDS[_category(sample)](args, sample, **kwargs)

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Use an existing Ray cluster; resource ownership stays with slime.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+TASK_EXAMPLE_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
+TASK_REPO_ROOT=$(cd -- "${TASK_EXAMPLE_DIR}/../.." && pwd)
+TASK_MODE=${1:?Expected grpo or mopd}
+shift
+case "${TASK_MODE}" in
+  grpo|mopd) ;;
+  *) echo "Expected grpo or mopd, got ${TASK_MODE}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac
+
+: "${HF_CHECKPOINT:?Set HF_CHECKPOINT to the matching Prism inference artifact}"
+: "${PROMPT_DATA:?Set PROMPT_DATA to your localized Prism JSONL dataset}"
+: "${OMNI_CONFIG:?Set OMNI_CONFIG to the student pipeline YAML}"
+TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON=${TRAIN_PYTHON:-python3}
+TASK_OMNI_PYTHON=${OMNI_PYTHON:-${TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON}}
+TASK_OUTPUT_DIR=${OUTPUT_DIR:-${PWD}/runs/prism-${TASK_MODE}}
+TASK_ACTOR_NODES=${ACTOR_NODES:-1}
+TASK_ACTOR_GPUS=${ACTOR_GPUS_PER_NODE:-1}
+TASK_ROLLOUT_GPUS=${ROLLOUT_GPUS:-1}
+TASK_COLOCATE=${COLOCATE:-0}
+[[ ${TASK_COLOCATE} == 0 || ${TASK_COLOCATE} == 1 ]] || { echo "COLOCATE must be 0 or 1" >&2; exit 2; }
+TASK_PROMPTS_PER_BATCH=${PROMPTS_PER_BATCH:-2}
+if [[ ${TASK_MODE} == grpo ]]; then
+  TASK_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT=${SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT:-4}
+else
+  TASK_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT=${SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT:-1}
+fi
+for TASK_INPUT_PATH in "${HF_CHECKPOINT}/config.json" "${PROMPT_DATA}" "${OMNI_CONFIG}"; do
+  [[ -f ${TASK_INPUT_PATH} ]] || { echo "Missing input file: ${TASK_INPUT_PATH}" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+for TASK_COUNT in "${TASK_ACTOR_NODES}" "${TASK_ACTOR_GPUS}" "${TASK_ROLLOUT_GPUS}" \
+                  "${TASK_PROMPTS_PER_BATCH}" "${TASK_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT}"; do
+  [[ ${TASK_COUNT} =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo "Resource and batch counts must be positive integers" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+TASK_GPUS_PER_NODE=${GPUS_PER_NODE:-$((TASK_ACTOR_GPUS + TASK_ROLLOUT_GPUS))}
+if [[ ${TASK_COLOCATE} == 1 ]]; then
+  TASK_GPUS_PER_NODE=${GPUS_PER_NODE:-${TASK_ACTOR_GPUS}}
+fi
+TASK_GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE:-$((TASK_PROMPTS_PER_BATCH * TASK_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT))}
+for TASK_COUNT in "${TASK_GPUS_PER_NODE}" "${TASK_GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE}"; do
+  [[ ${TASK_COUNT} =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo "Resource and batch counts must be positive integers" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+TASK_DP_SIZE=$((TASK_ACTOR_NODES * TASK_ACTOR_GPUS))
+(( TASK_GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE % TASK_DP_SIZE == 0 )) || {
+  echo "GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE must be divisible by the learner DP size (${TASK_DP_SIZE})" >&2; exit 2;
+}
+
+export PYTHONPATH="${TASK_REPO_ROOT}${MEGATRON_ROOT:+:${MEGATRON_ROOT}}${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}"
+export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
+export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=${CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:-1}
+export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=${NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE:-0}
+export RAY_ADDRESS=${RAY_ADDRESS:-auto}
+# Explicitly carry the model import path into remote Megatron workers.
+TASK_TRAIN_ENV=$("${TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON}" - <<'PY'
+import json
+import os
+print(json.dumps({key: os.environ[key] for key in (
+    "PYTHONPATH", "PYTHONUNBUFFERED", "CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS", "NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE"
+)}))
+PY
+)
+
+# Produce ordinary Megatron flags before its parser and HF validation run.
+# A file preserves argument boundaries and propagates configuration failures.
+TASK_ARCH_ARGS_FILE=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f -- "${TASK_ARCH_ARGS_FILE}"' EXIT
+"${TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON}" - "${HF_CHECKPOINT}" > "${TASK_ARCH_ARGS_FILE}" <<'PY'
+import sys
+
+from slime_plugins.models.prism import prism_megatron_cli_args
+
+for argument in prism_megatron_cli_args(sys.argv[1]):
+    sys.stdout.buffer.write(argument.encode() + b"\0")
+PY
+mapfile -d '' -t TASK_ARCH_ARGS < "${TASK_ARCH_ARGS_FILE}"
+rm -f -- "${TASK_ARCH_ARGS_FILE}"
+trap - EXIT
+
+TASK_ARGS=(
+  "${TASK_ARCH_ARGS[@]}"
+  --actor-num-nodes "${TASK_ACTOR_NODES}"
+  --actor-num-gpus-per-node "${TASK_ACTOR_GPUS}"
+  --rollout-num-gpus "${TASK_ROLLOUT_GPUS}"
+  --num-gpus-per-node "${TASK_GPUS_PER_NODE}"
+  --rollout-num-gpus-per-engine 1
+  --rollout-backend sglang-omni
+  --omni-python "${TASK_OMNI_PYTHON}"
+  --omni-config "${OMNI_CONFIG}"
+  --omni-model-name student
+  --omni-router-policy least_request
+  --hf-checkpoint "${HF_CHECKPOINT}"
+  --model-name moss_tts_prism
+  --custom-model-provider-path slime_plugins.models.prism.model_provider
+  --custom-megatron-log-prob-function-path slime_plugins.models.prism.extract_policy_log_probs
+  --rollout-function-path slime.rollout.sglang_rollout.generate_rollout
+  --custom-generate-function-path slime_plugins.omni_rollout.generate
+  --custom-config-path "${TASK_EXAMPLE_DIR}/${TASK_MODE}.yaml"
+  --train-env-vars "${TASK_TRAIN_ENV}"
+  --prompt-data "${PROMPT_DATA}"
+  --input-key script
+  --metadata-key metadata
+  --rollout-shuffle
+  --num-rollout "${NUM_ROLLOUT:-100}"
+  --rollout-batch-size "${TASK_PROMPTS_PER_BATCH}"
+  --n-samples-per-prompt "${TASK_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT}"
+  --rollout-max-response-len "${MAX_FRAMES:-512}"
+  --rollout-temperature 1
+  --rollout-top-p 1
+  --rollout-top-k -1
+  --sglang-server-concurrency "${ROLLOUT_CONCURRENCY_PER_REPLICA:-2}"
+  --global-batch-size "${TASK_GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE}"
+  --micro-batch-size 1
+  --advantage-estimator grpo
+  --loss-type policy_loss
+  --kl-coef 0
+  --entropy-coef 0
+  --eps-clip 0.2
+  --eps-clip-high 0.2
+  --policy-stop-loss-weight "${STOP_LOSS_WEIGHT:-1}"
+  --update-weight-mode full
+  --update-weight-transport nccl
+  --tensor-model-parallel-size 1
+  --pipeline-model-parallel-size 1
+  --context-parallel-size 1
+  --expert-model-parallel-size 1
+  --expert-tensor-parallel-size 1
+  --seq-length "${TRAIN_SEQ_LENGTH:-4096}"
+  --bf16
+  --transformer-impl transformer_engine
+  --attention-dropout 0
+  --hidden-dropout 0
+  --accumulate-allreduce-grads-in-fp32
+  --recompute-granularity full
+  --recompute-method uniform
+  --recompute-num-layers 1
+  --optimizer adam
+  --lr "${LEARNING_RATE:-1e-6}"
+  --lr-decay-style constant
+  --weight-decay "${WEIGHT_DECAY:-0.01}"
+  --adam-beta1 0.9
+  --adam-beta2 0.98
+  --save "${TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}"
+  --save-interval "${SAVE_INTERVAL:-10}"
+)
+
+if [[ ${TASK_COLOCATE} == 1 ]]; then
+  TASK_ARGS+=(--colocate)
+fi
+
+if [[ -n ${RL_LOAD:-} ]]; then
+  [[ -d ${RL_LOAD} ]] || { echo "Missing RL checkpoint directory: ${RL_LOAD}" >&2; exit 2; }
+  TASK_ARGS+=(--load "${RL_LOAD}")
+else
+  : "${PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT:?Set PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT for the first run, or RL_LOAD for resume}"
+  [[ -d ${PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT} ]] || {
+    echo "Missing native Prism checkpoint: ${PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT}" >&2; exit 2;
+  }
+  TASK_ARGS+=(
+    --custom-megatron-model-initializer-path slime_plugins.models.prism.load_prism_pretrained
+    --pretrained-checkpoint "${PRISM_PRETRAINED_CHECKPOINT}"
+  )
+  if [[ -n ${PRISM_PRETRAINED_STEP:-} ]]; then
+    TASK_ARGS+=(--ckpt-step "${PRISM_PRETRAINED_STEP}")
+  fi
+fi
+
+if [[ ${TASK_MODE} == grpo ]]; then
+  : "${REWARD_CONFIG:?Set REWARD_CONFIG to frozen WER/SIM/JudgeCLAP service bindings}"
+  [[ -f ${REWARD_CONFIG} ]] || { echo "Missing reward config: ${REWARD_CONFIG}" >&2; exit 2; }
+  TASK_ARGS+=(
+    --custom-rm-path slime_plugins.tts_reward.reward
+    --omni-reward-config "${REWARD_CONFIG}"
+    --omni-audio-dir "${AUDIO_DIR:-${TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/audio}"
+  )
+else
+  : "${TEACHER_CONFIG:?Set TEACHER_CONFIG to domain-to-frozen-Prism-teacher bindings}"
+  [[ -f ${TEACHER_CONFIG} ]] || { echo "Missing teacher config: ${TEACHER_CONFIG}" >&2; exit 2; }
+  TASK_ARGS+=(
+    --use-opd
+    --opd-type sglang
+    --opd-kl-coef "${OPD_KL_COEF:-1}"
+    --rollout-sample-hook-path slime_plugins.omni_rollout.score_teacher
+    --omni-teacher-config "${TEACHER_CONFIG}"
+    --custom-rm-path examples.prism.hooks.zero_reward
+  )
+fi
+
+# Keep actual Omni scores for diagnostics; no --use-rollout-logprobs means
+# Megatron recomputes and freezes old selected scores before optimization.
+if [[ ${PRISM_DRY_RUN:-0} == 1 ]]; then
+  printf '%q ' "${TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON}" "${TASK_REPO_ROOT}/train.py" "${TASK_ARGS[@]}" "$@"
+  printf '\n'
+  exit 0
+fi
+exec "${TASK_TRAIN_PYTHON}" "${TASK_REPO_ROOT}/train.py" "${TASK_ARGS[@]}" "$@"

+"""A read-only numerical oracle hook for the TP1 Prism GPU smoke.
+
+Run ``diagnose`` as --before-trajectory-hook with a saved --trajectory-json.
+The hook compares the native model, functional projections of its captured
+head inputs, and the user's converted Hugging Face model at the same BF16
+dtype. It never updates weights, optimizer state, action masks or tolerances.
+Only this user-provided artifact is loaded with trust_remote_code=True.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def canonical_rows(value: torch.Tensor, *, native: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Convert [T,1,H] native state or [1,T,H] HF state to [1,T,H]."""
+    if value.ndim != 3 or value.shape[1 if native else 0] != 1:
+        raise ValueError("the numerical diagnostic requires one packed TP1 sample")
+    return value.transpose(0, 1) if native else value
+
+
+def selected_scores(rvq_logits, stop_logits, codes, stops):
+    """Return the native Q-code-plus-stop layout from either model's logits."""
+    if rvq_logits.ndim != 4 or tuple(rvq_logits.shape[:-1]) != tuple(codes.shape):
+        raise ValueError("RVQ logits and successor codes must have shape [1,T,Q,V] / [1,T,Q]")
+    if tuple(stop_logits.shape) != (*stops.shape, 2) or tuple(stops.shape) != tuple(codes.shape[:2]):
+        raise ValueError("stop logits/actions must align with the chronological rows")
+    code_scores = rvq_logits.float().log_softmax(-1).gather(-1, codes.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    stop_scores = stop_logits.float().log_softmax(-1).gather(-1, stops.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    return torch.cat((code_scores, stop_scores.unsqueeze(-1)), dim=-1)
+
+
+def differences(actual, expected, mask=None):
+    if actual.shape != expected.shape:
+        raise ValueError(f"diagnostic shapes differ: {actual.shape} versus {expected.shape}")
+    delta = (actual.detach().float() - expected.detach().float()).abs()
+    if mask is not None:
+        delta = delta[mask]
+    if not delta.numel():
+        return {"count": 0, "max_abs_diff": None, "mean_abs_diff": None}
+    return {
+        "count": delta.numel(),
+        "max_abs_diff": delta.max().item(),
+        "mean_abs_diff": delta.mean().item(),
+    }
+
+
+def rms_rounding_references(raw, gamma, eps):
+    """Pure tensor references for one versus two BF16 rounding boundaries."""
+    if raw.shape[-1] != gamma.numel() or gamma.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("RMSNorm gamma must match the captured hidden width")
+    normalized = raw.float() * torch.rsqrt(raw.float().square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    return {
+        "single": (normalized * gamma.float()).to(raw.dtype),
+        "double": normalized.to(raw.dtype) * gamma.to(raw.dtype),
+    }
+
+
+def _sglang_prediction_norms(model, captures, rows, eps):
+    """Call the real SGLang operator; missing runtime context is explicit."""
+    try:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+    except (ImportError, RuntimeError) as error:
+        return {"status": "unavailable", "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}, {}
+    report, tensors = {"status": "measured", "sites": {}}, {}
+    for index, native_norm in enumerate(model.prediction_norms):
+        key = str(index)
+        raw, actual = captures["norms"][key]["raw"], captures["norms"][key]["normalized"]
+        gamma = native_norm.weight.detach()
+        references = rms_rounding_references(raw, gamma, eps)
+        try:
+            norm = RMSNorm(raw.shape[-1], eps=eps).to(device=raw.device, dtype=raw.dtype).eval()
+            norm.weight.copy_(gamma)
+            result = norm(raw.squeeze(0).contiguous(), None)
+            if not isinstance(result, torch.Tensor) or result.shape != raw.shape[1:]:
+                raise TypeError("SGLang RMSNorm with residual=None did not return a [T,H] tensor")
+            result = result.unsqueeze(0)
+            tensors[key] = result.detach().clone()
+            report["sites"][key] = {
+                "status": "measured",
+                "input_dtype": str(raw.dtype),
+                "output_dtype": str(result.dtype),
+                "vs_native_same_raw": differences(result, actual, rows),
+                "vs_torch_single": differences(result, references["single"], rows),
+                "vs_torch_double": differences(result, references["double"], rows),
+            }
+        except Exception as error:
+            report["status"] = "partially_unavailable"
+            report["sites"][key] = {"status": "unavailable", "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
+    return report, tensors
+
+
+def score_differences(actual, expected, prepared):
+    q = prepared["code_mask"].shape[-1]
+    if actual.shape[-1] != q + 1:
+        raise ValueError("unexpected native selected-score layout")
+    code_mask, stop_mask = prepared["code_mask"], prepared["stop_mask"]
+    report = {
+        "code": differences(actual[..., :q], expected[..., :q], code_mask),
+        "stop": differences(actual[..., q], expected[..., q], stop_mask),
+        "per_channel": [
+            differences(actual[..., channel], expected[..., channel], code_mask[..., channel]) for channel in range(q)
+        ],
+    }
+    return report
+
+
+def oracle_inputs(batch, spec):
+    """Use exactly the native padded time dimension with padding attention hidden."""
+    from slime_plugins.models.prism import prepare_policy_inputs
+
+    if len(batch["total_lengths"]) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("HF oracle comparisons currently require one trajectory")
+    mm = batch["multimodal_train_inputs"]
+    prepared = prepare_policy_inputs(
+        batch["tokens"],
+        audio_codes=mm["audio_codes"],
+        item_kind=mm["item_kind"],
+        audio_role=mm["audio_role"],
+        successor_audio_codes=mm["successor_audio_codes"],
+        successor_audio_mask=mm["successor_audio_mask"],
+        target_history_retention_mask=mm.get("target_history_retention_mask"),
+        policy_code_mask=mm["policy_code_mask"],
+        policy_stop_mask=mm["policy_stop_mask"],
+        policy_stop_actions=mm["policy_stop_actions"],
+        n_vq=spec.topology.n_vq,
+        speech_vocab_size=spec.speech_vocab_size,
+        text_vocab_size=spec.text_vocab_size,
+        text_pad_idx=spec.text_pad_idx,
+        audio_start_token_id=spec.audio_start_token_id,
+        cu_seqlens=batch["packed_seq_params"].cu_seqlens_q,
+    )
+    time = batch["tokens"].shape[1]
+    length = int(batch["total_lengths"][0])
+    attention = torch.arange(time, device=batch["tokens"].device).unsqueeze(0) < length
+    inputs = {
+        "input_ids": prepared["tokens"],
+        "attention_mask": attention,
+        "position_ids": torch.arange(time, device=attention.device).unsqueeze(0),
+        "item_kind": prepared["item_kind"],
+        "audio_role": prepared["audio_role"],
+        "target_history_retention_mask": prepared["retention"],
+        "successor_audio_mask": prepared["successor_mask"],
+        "successor_audio_codes": prepared["successor_codes"],
+        "use_cache": False,
+        "return_dict": True,
+    }
+    if "loop_block_prefix_counts" in mm:
+        inputs["loop_block_prefix_counts"] = mm["loop_block_prefix_counts"]
+    return inputs, prepared
+
+
+def _capture(model, *, native):
+    captures, handles = {"norms": {}, "heads": {}, "stop": {}}, []
+
+    def norm(index):
+        def hook(_module, inputs, output):
+            captures["norms"][str(index)] = {
+                "raw": canonical_rows(inputs[0].detach().clone(), native=native),
+                "normalized": canonical_rows(output.detach().clone(), native=native),
+            }
+
+        return hook
+
+    def head(index, *, stop=False):
+        def hook(_module, inputs, output):
+            logits = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output
+            value = {
+                "input": canonical_rows(inputs[0].detach().clone(), native=native),
+                "logits": canonical_rows(logits.detach().clone(), native=native),
+            }
+            if stop:
+                captures["stop"] = value
+            else:
+                captures["heads"][str(index)] = value
+
+        return hook
+
+    for index, module in enumerate(model.prediction_norms):
+        handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(norm(index)))
+    for index, module in enumerate(model.audio_lm_heads):
+        handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(head(index)))
+    handles.append(model.stop_head.register_forward_hook(head(0, stop=True)))
+    return captures, handles
+
+
+def _cpu(value):
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        return value.detach().cpu()
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return {key: _cpu(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    return value
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def activation_fusion(model, enabled):
+    """Temporarily select MCore's own SwiGLU path and restore shared configs."""
+    configs = {id(layer.mlp.config): layer.mlp.config for layer in model.decoder.layers}
+    previous = [(config, config.bias_activation_fusion) for config in configs.values()]
+    try:
+        for config, _ in previous:
+            config.bias_activation_fusion = enabled
+        yield
+    finally:
+        for config, value in previous:
+            config.bias_activation_fusion = value
+
+
+def _activation_capture(model):
+    """Record actual FC1 output and FC2 input; no replacement activation."""
+    values, handles = {}, []
+    indices = (0, *model.config.prism_mlp_only_layers[:1])
+
+    def before(index):
+        def hook(_module, _inputs, output):
+            tensor = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output
+            values.setdefault(str(index), {}).setdefault("pre_activation", tensor.detach().clone())
+
+        return hook
+
+    def after(index):
+        def hook(_module, inputs):
+            values.setdefault(str(index), {}).setdefault("post_activation", inputs[0].detach().clone())
+
+        return hook
+
+    for index in indices:
+        mlp = model.decoder.layers[index].mlp
+        handles.append(mlp.linear_fc1.register_forward_hook(before(index)))
+        handles.append(mlp.linear_fc2.register_forward_pre_hook(after(index)))
+    return values, handles
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def diagnose(context):
+    """Smoke before-hook; GPU execution and the HF artifact are explicit inputs."""
+    from scripts.test_prism_gpu import forward, input_samples, make_batch
+    from transformers import AutoModel
+
+    from slime_plugins.models.prism import read_prism_spec
+
+    args, wrapper = context["args"], context["model"]
+    if not args.trajectory_json or args.omni_url:
+        raise ValueError("the oracle hook requires an immutable saved Omni trajectory")
+    model = wrapper
+    while hasattr(model, "module"):
+        model = model.module
+    spec = read_prism_spec(args.hf_checkpoint)
+    if model.config.tensor_model_parallel_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError("the functional head oracle requires TP=1")
+    output = Path(context["artifact_dir"])
+    samples, _ = input_samples(args, spec, output)
+    _, batch = make_batch(samples)
+    inputs, prepared = oracle_inputs(batch, spec)
+    rows = prepared["code_mask"].any(-1)

+"""Hooks for a real learner update and full NCCL publication to Omni replicas.
+
+Used by scripts.test_prism_omni in publication mode. The learner uses GPU 0;
+the pipeline GPUs supplied to that script must exclude GPU 0. No Ray service
+is created by this smoke: the existing engine control methods and the same
+weight mapping used by the distributed updater are exercised directly.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import socket
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_engines = []
+_learner = None
+_group = None
+_executor = None
+_group_name = "prism-publication-smoke"
+_timeout = 600.0
+
+
+def _wait(futures):
+    return [future.result(timeout=_timeout) for future in futures]
+
+
+def _connect():
+    global _group
+    from slime.utils.distributed_utils import init_process_group
+
+    with socket.socket() as sock:
+        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
+    futures = [
+        _executor.submit(
+            engine.init_weights_update_group,
+            master_address="127.0.0.1",
+            master_port=port,
+            rank_offset=index + 1,
+            world_size=len(_engines) + 1,
+            group_name=_group_name,
+            backend="nccl",
+        )
+        for index, engine in enumerate(_engines)
+    ]
+    _group = init_process_group(
+        backend="nccl",
+        init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}",
+        world_size=len(_engines) + 1,
+        rank=0,
+        group_name=_group_name,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=_timeout),
+    )
+    _wait(futures)
+
+
+def _publish(context, version):
+    import torch
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    from slime.backends.megatron_utils.megatron_to_hf import convert_to_hf
+    from slime.backends.megatron_utils.update_weight.common import all_gather_param, named_params_and_buffers
+
+    args, model = context["runtime"], context["model"]
+    buckets, tensors, byte_count = 0, 0, 0
+    buffer = []
+    buffer_bytes = 0
+
+    def send():
+        nonlocal buckets, tensors, byte_count
+        if not buffer:
+            return
+        futures = [
+            _executor.submit(
+                engine.update_weights_from_distributed,
+                names=[name for name, _ in buffer],
+                dtypes=[tensor.dtype for _, tensor in buffer],
+                shapes=[tensor.shape for _, tensor in buffer],
+                group_name=_group_name,
+                weight_version=version,
+            )
+            for engine in _engines
+        ]
+        handles = [dist.broadcast(tensor, 0, group=_group, async_op=True) for _, tensor in buffer]
+        for handle in handles:
+            handle.wait()
+        _wait(futures)
+        buckets += 1
+        tensors += len(buffer)
+        byte_count += sum(tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size() for _, tensor in buffer)
+        buffer.clear()
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name, parameter in named_params_and_buffers(args, [model]):
+            converted = convert_to_hf(args, "moss_tts_prism", name, all_gather_param(name, parameter), None)
+            size = sum(tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size() for _, tensor in converted)
+            if buffer and buffer_bytes + size > 64 * 1024**2:
+                send()
+                buffer_bytes = 0
+            buffer.extend(converted)
+            buffer_bytes += size
+        send()
+    return {"weight_version": version, "buckets": buckets, "tensors": tensors, "bytes": byte_count}
+
+
+def before_trajectory(context):
+    """Install the native student, activate replicas, then sample its trajectory."""
+    _connect()
+    report = _publish(context, "1")
+    for engine in _engines:
+        engine.continue_generation()
+    context["args"].expected_weight_version = "1"
+    return report
+
+
+def after_update(context):
+    """Install the updated policy and leave admission closed for the controller."""
+    for engine in _engines:
+        engine.pause_generation()
+    return _publish(context, "2")
+
+
+def _cleanup():
+    global _group, _executor
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    if _group is not None:
+        futures = [_executor.submit(engine.destroy_weights_update_group, _group_name) for engine in _engines]
+        group, _group = _group, None
+        dist.destroy_process_group(group)
+        _wait(futures)
+    if _executor is not None:
+        _executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
+        _executor = None
+    if dist.is_initialized():
+        from megatron.core import mpu
+
+        mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def publication(engines, context):
+    """Controller hook: native load → v1 → real rollout → Adam step → v2."""
+    global _engines, _learner, _executor, _timeout
+    from scripts.test_prism_gpu import run
+
+    if 0 in context["gpu_ids"]:
+        raise ValueError("Reserve GPU 0 for the learner; Omni replicas must use other GPUs")
+    if not context.get("native_checkpoint"):
+        raise ValueError("Publication smoke requires --native-checkpoint")
+    options = context.get("publication_args", {})
+    if "alignment_atol" not in options:
+        raise ValueError("Set an explicit alignment_atol in --publication-args-json")
+    _engines = engines
+    _timeout = context["startup_timeout"]
+    _executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(engines))
+    output = Path(context["artifact_dir"]) / "learner"
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    prompt = output / "prompt.json"
+    prompt.write_text(
+        json.dumps({"script": context["text"], "task_type": context["task_type"], "show_language": False})
+    )
+    args = argparse.Namespace(
+        hf_checkpoint=context["hf_checkpoint"],
+        pretrained_checkpoint=context["native_checkpoint"],
+        ckpt_step=options.get("native_step"),
+        custom_megatron_model_initializer_path="slime_plugins.models.prism.load_prism_pretrained",
+        artifact_dir=str(output),
+        numpy_overlay=None,
+        omni_url=context["router_url"],
+        trajectory_json=None,
+        prompt_json=str(prompt),
+        omni_model_name="student",
+        expected_weight_version="1",
+        max_frames=options.get("learner_max_frames", 8),
+        request_timeout=context["request_timeout"],
+        alignment_atol=options["alignment_atol"],
+        alignment_rtol=options.get("alignment_rtol", 0.0),
+        learning_rate=options.get("learning_rate", 1e-3),
+        stop_loss_weight=1.0,
+        before_trajectory_hook="scripts.prism_publication_smoke.before_trajectory",
+        after_update_hook="scripts.prism_publication_smoke.after_update",
+    )
+    try:
+        _learner = run(args, [])
+        return {**_learner["report"]["after_update"], "learner": _learner["report"]}
+    except BaseException:
+        _cleanup()
+        raise
+
+
+def verify_generated(context, response, sample):
+    """Compare updated Omni actions with the live updated Megatron student."""
+    import torch
+
+    from scripts.test_prism_gpu import compare_omni_scores, forward, make_batch
+    from slime_plugins.models.prism import extract_policy_log_probs
+
+    if _learner is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Run the publication hook before post-generation verification")
+    try:
+        _, batch = make_batch([sample])
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            scores = extract_policy_log_probs(_learner["learner_args"], batch, forward(_learner["model"], batch))
+        report = compare_omni_scores(_learner["args"], [sample], scores)
+        if not all(values["aligned"] for values in report.values()):
+            raise AssertionError(f"Published Omni policy differs from the updated student: {report}")
+        return report
+    finally:
+        _cleanup()

+r"""Real Prism native-load, selected-action backward and MCore Adam smoke.
+
+Run inside the GPU image with Megatron on PYTHONPATH, for example::
+
+    PYTHONPATH=/opt/megatron:$PWD torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=1 \
+      scripts/test_prism_gpu.py \
+      --hf-checkpoint /shared/prism-hf \
+      --pretrained-checkpoint /shared/prism-native \
+      --artifact-dir /shared/prism-smoke \
+      --numpy-overlay /shared/numpy1 \
+      --omni-url http://worker-or-router:port \
+      --prompt-json /shared/prism-prompt.json --alignment-atol 0.05
+
+The tolerance above is an example: choose it explicitly for the tested dtype
+and kernels. Both RVQ and stop differences are reported before any update.
+Without an Omni URL or saved /generate response this runs a synthetic carrier
+smoke, which verifies GPU execution but does not establish engine alignment.
+NCCL publication can be added with --after-update-hook module.function. The
+hook receives the still-live CUDA student, optimizer, replay and score results.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import socket
+import sys
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def cli_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
+    parser.add_argument("--hf-checkpoint", required=True, help="Converted Prism inference artifact directory.")
+    parser.add_argument("--pretrained-checkpoint", required=True, help="Native RUN/checkpoint/iteration directory.")
+    parser.add_argument("--ckpt-step", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--custom-megatron-model-initializer-path", default="slime_plugins.models.prism.load_prism_pretrained"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--artifact-dir", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--numpy-overlay", help="Directory containing NumPy 1.x, prepended before importing Megatron.")
+    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
+    source.add_argument("--omni-url", help="Live Omni worker/router URL; /generate is appended if needed.")
+    source.add_argument("--trajectory-json", help="Saved complete Omni /generate response JSON.")
+    parser.add_argument("--prompt-json", help="Original structured Omni prompt JSON, required for real trajectories.")
+    parser.add_argument("--omni-model-name", default="student")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-frames", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--request-timeout", type=float, default=600)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--alignment-atol", type=float, help="Required explicit numerical bound for Omni trajectories."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--alignment-rtol", type=float, default=0.0)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--expected-weight-version", help="Optional required admission version for the real trajectory."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=1e-3)
+    parser.add_argument("--stop-loss-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--before-trajectory-hook", help="Optional function(context) to publish initial weights before generation."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--after-update-hook", help="Optional function(context) for publication/serving verification.")
+    values, megatron_flags = parser.parse_known_args()
+    if (values.omni_url or values.trajectory_json) and not values.prompt_json:
+        parser.error("Omni replay requires --prompt-json; task/reference metadata must be explicit")
+    if (values.omni_url or values.trajectory_json) and values.alignment_atol is None:
+        parser.error("Omni replay requires an explicit --alignment-atol")
+    for name in ("alignment_atol", "alignment_rtol", "learning_rate", "stop_loss_weight"):
+        value = getattr(values, name)
+        if value is not None and (not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0):
+            parser.error(f"--{name.replace('_', '-')} must be finite and nonnegative")
+    if values.learning_rate == 0 or values.max_frames < 1:
+        parser.error("learning rate and max frames must be positive")
+    return values, megatron_flags
+
+
+def setup(args, extra_flags):
+    if args.numpy_overlay:
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(args.numpy_overlay).resolve()))
+    import numpy as np
+    import torch
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+    from megatron.core import mpu, tensor_parallel
+    from megatron.training.arguments import parse_args, validate_args
+    from megatron.training.global_vars import set_args
+
+    from slime_plugins.models.prism import prism_megatron_cli_args, read_prism_spec
+
+    if not np.__version__.startswith("1."):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Megatron requires NumPy 1.x; found {np.__version__}. Use --numpy-overlay.")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        raise RuntimeError("This smoke requires a real CUDA GPU and Transformer Engine.")
+    if int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("This first GPU smoke supports one learner rank, TP=PP=CP=DP=1.")
+    previous_argv = sys.argv
+    try:
+        sys.argv = [previous_argv[0], *prism_megatron_cli_args(args.hf_checkpoint), *extra_flags]
+        runtime = parse_args()
+    finally:
+        sys.argv = previous_argv
+    runtime.hf_checkpoint = str(Path(args.hf_checkpoint).resolve())
+    runtime.load = None
+    runtime.pretrained_checkpoint = str(Path(args.pretrained_checkpoint).resolve())
+    runtime.ckpt_step = args.ckpt_step
+    runtime.custom_megatron_model_initializer_path = args.custom_megatron_model_initializer_path
+    spec = read_prism_spec(runtime.hf_checkpoint)
+    # A smoke creates its own fresh RL optimizer. Architecture/dtype comes
+    # exclusively from the inference artifact validated against native DCP.
+    runtime.bf16, runtime.fp16 = spec.dtype == "bfloat16", spec.dtype == "float16"
+    runtime.micro_batch_size = 1
+    runtime.global_batch_size = 1
+    runtime.seq_length = max(128, runtime.seq_length or 128)
+    runtime.train_iters = 1
+    runtime.lr = args.learning_rate
+    runtime.hidden_dropout = runtime.attention_dropout = 0.0
+    runtime.variable_seq_lengths = True
+    runtime.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+    validate_args(runtime)
+    if (runtime.tensor_model_parallel_size, runtime.pipeline_model_parallel_size, runtime.context_parallel_size) != (
+        1,
+        1,
+        1,
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("This first GPU smoke requires TP=PP=CP=1.")
+    set_args(runtime)
+    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", "0")))
+    # This smoke always has one learner rank. Platform MASTER_* variables
+    # can describe another service; even a one-rank torchrun needs no shared
+    # rendezvous here. Give the learner its own local TCP port.
+    with socket.socket() as sock:
+        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "nccl",
+        init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}",
+        rank=0,
+        world_size=1,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=args.request_timeout),
+    )
+    mpu.initialize_model_parallel(
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=1,
+        pipeline_model_parallel_size=1,
+        context_parallel_size=1,
+        create_gloo_process_groups=False,
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(runtime.seed)
+    tensor_parallel.model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(runtime.seed)
+    return runtime, spec, np.__version__
+
+
+def input_samples(args, spec, output):
+    import torch
+
+    from slime.utils.types import Sample
+    from slime_plugins.omni_rollout import PrismConfig, build_generate_payload, parse_rollout
+
+    if args.omni_url or args.trajectory_json:
+        sample = Sample(index=0, group_index=0)
+        sample.metadata = {"omni_prompt": json.loads(Path(args.prompt_json).read_text())}
+        sample.prompt = sample.metadata["omni_prompt"]["script"]
+        if args.omni_url:
+            import urllib.request
+
+            args.omni_return_audio = False
+            payload = build_generate_payload(args, sample, {"max_new_tokens": args.max_frames, "seed": 42})
+            url = args.omni_url.rstrip("/")
+            if not url.endswith("/generate"):
+                url += "/generate"
+            (output / "generate-request.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+            request = urllib.request.Request(
+                url, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+            )
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=args.request_timeout) as response:
+                result = json.load(response)
+        else:
+            result = json.loads(Path(args.trajectory_json).read_text())
+        (output / "generate-response.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+        parse_rollout(
+            result,
+            sample,
+            PrismConfig.from_path(args.hf_checkpoint),
+            expected_weight_version=args.expected_weight_version,
+        )
+        return [sample], "omni"
+
+    samples = []
+    for index, (frames, natural, advantage) in enumerate(((2, True, 1.0), (2, False, -0.6), (0, True, 0.4))):
+        q, rows = spec.topology.n_vq, frames + 1
+        codes = (torch.arange(frames * q).reshape(frames, q) % max(spec.speech_vocab_size - 1, 1)) + 1
+        codes %= spec.speech_vocab_size
+        mask = torch.arange(rows) < frames
+        stops = mask.clone()
+        stop_actions = torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.long)
+        if natural:
+            stops[-1], stop_actions[-1] = True, 1

+"""Prism's physical Megatron parameters to Omni's HF weight-loading names.
+
+QKV is group-major ``[Q_group, K_group, V_group]``; gathered SwiGLU FC1 is
+``[all gate rows, all up rows]``. Repeated execution units share physical layer
+parameters and must never be expanded during publication. These mappings match
+mossLite's Prism native-to-HF converter and Omni's ``load_weights`` contract.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+import torch
+
+from slime.backends.megatron_utils.misc_utils import strip_param_name_prefix
+
+
+def is_prism_model(model_name: str) -> bool:
+    family = model_name.lower().replace("_", "").replace("-", "")
+    return family in {"prism", "mossttsprism", "mossttsprismconfig", "mossttsprismmodel"}
+
+
+def _dimension(args, name: str) -> int:
+    value = getattr(args, name, None)
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"Prism weight conversion requires positive {name}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _inference_dtype(args, source_dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.dtype:
+    value = getattr(args, "sglang_dtype", "auto")
+    if value in (None, "auto"):
+        return source_dtype
+    aliases = {
+        "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16,
+        "bf16": torch.bfloat16,
+        "float16": torch.float16,
+        "fp16": torch.float16,
+        "half": torch.float16,
+        "float32": torch.float32,
+        "fp32": torch.float32,
+        "float": torch.float32,
+    }
+    dtype = aliases.get(value) if isinstance(value, str) else value
+    if dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported Prism inference dtype: {value}")
+    return dtype
+
+
+def convert_prism_to_hf(args, name: str, param: torch.Tensor) -> list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Convert one complete, TP-gathered parameter without altering vocab padding.
+
+    ``sglang_dtype=auto`` preserves the trainable dtype. An explicit existing
+    ``--sglang-dtype bfloat16`` casts every published parameter, including norms
+    and stop, to BF16. The engine retains its FP32 stop projection computation.
+    """
+    if param.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported Prism trainable dtype: {param.dtype}")
+    name = strip_param_name_prefix(name)
+    hidden = _dimension(args, "hidden_size")
+
+    def checked(shape):
+        if tuple(param.shape) != shape:
+            raise ValueError(f"Prism shape mismatch for {name}: got {tuple(param.shape)}, expected {shape}")
+        return param.to(dtype=_inference_dtype(args, param.dtype)).contiguous()
+
+    if name == "text_embedding.word_embeddings.weight":
+        # The HF artifact owns the padded text vocabulary. Tokenizer vocab_size
+        # is smaller and must not truncate this matrix, unlike text-only models.
+        return [("transformer.embed_tokens.weight", checked((_dimension(args, "padded_vocab_size"), hidden)))]
+    if name == "stop_head.weight":
+        return [(name, checked((2, hidden)))]
+
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"(audio_embeddings|audio_lm_heads)\.(\d+)\.(word_embeddings\.)?weight", name)
+    if match:
+        module, channel, embedding = match.groups()
+        if (module == "audio_embeddings") != (embedding is not None) or int(channel) >= _dimension(args, "n_vq"):
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown Prism parameter: {name}")
+        return [(f"{module}.{channel}.weight", checked((_dimension(args, "speech_vocab_size"), hidden)))]
+
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"prediction_norms\.(\d+)\.weight", name)
+    if match:
+        counts = getattr(args, "prism_rvq_heads_per_execution_unit", ())
+        if int(match[1]) >= sum(count > 0 for count in counts):
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown Prism prediction norm: {name}")
+        return [(name, checked((hidden,)))]
+
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"decoder\.layers\.(\d+)\.(.+)", name)
+    if match is None or int(match[1]) >= _dimension(args, "num_layers"):
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown Prism parameter: {name}")
+    layer, suffix = match.groups()
+    target = f"transformer.layers.{layer}"
+    mlp_only = int(layer) in getattr(args, "prism_mlp_only_layers", ())
+    ffn = _dimension(args, "ffn_hidden_size")
+
+    if suffix == "mlp.linear_fc1.layer_norm_weight":
+        return [(f"{target}.post_attention_layernorm.weight", checked((hidden,)))]
+    if suffix == "mlp.linear_fc1.weight":
+        gate, up = checked((2 * ffn, hidden)).chunk(2, dim=0)
+        return [(f"{target}.mlp.gate_proj.weight", gate), (f"{target}.mlp.up_proj.weight", up)]
+    if suffix == "mlp.linear_fc2.weight":
+        return [(f"{target}.mlp.down_proj.weight", checked((hidden, ffn)))]
+    if mlp_only:
+        raise ValueError(f"MLP-only Prism layer cannot have attention parameter: {name}")
+
+    heads, groups = _dimension(args, "num_attention_heads"), _dimension(args, "num_query_groups")
+    head_dim = _dimension(args, "kv_channels")
+    if heads % groups:
+        raise ValueError("Prism query heads must be divisible by query groups")
+    q_per_group = heads // groups
+    if suffix == "self_attention.linear_qkv.weight":
+        qkv = checked(((heads + 2 * groups) * head_dim, hidden)).view(groups, q_per_group + 2, head_dim, hidden)
+        return [
+            (f"{target}.self_attn.q_proj.weight", qkv[:, :q_per_group].reshape(-1, hidden).contiguous()),
+            (f"{target}.self_attn.k_proj.weight", qkv[:, q_per_group].reshape(-1, hidden).contiguous()),
+            (f"{target}.self_attn.v_proj.weight", qkv[:, q_per_group + 1].reshape(-1, hidden).contiguous()),
+        ]
+    if suffix == "self_attention.linear_proj.weight":
+        return [(f"{target}.self_attn.o_proj.weight", checked((hidden, heads * head_dim)))]
+    if suffix == "self_attention.linear_qkv.layer_norm_weight":
+        return [(f"{target}.input_layernorm.weight", checked((hidden,)))]
+    if suffix in ("self_attention.q_layernorm.weight", "self_attention.k_layernorm.weight"):
+        axis = "q" if suffix == "self_attention.q_layernorm.weight" else "k"
+        return [(f"{target}.self_attn.{axis}_norm.weight", checked((head_dim,)))]
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown Prism parameter: {name}")
